purpose: Reusable source cards that turn public-record leads into claim/evidence/source/boundary/next-step cards.
rules: Claim strength must never exceed the source type.
A name in a document is not proof of guilt.
A settlement is not automatic admission.
A contact, email, flight, or logistics record is not automatic knowledge or participation.
Court findings, pleas, and convictions outrank reporting and commentary.

cards.claim: ECB says digital euro aims for potential first issuance during 2029 if EU legislation is adopted in 2026
cards.sourceLabel: ECB digital euro project page
cards.summary: The ECB states the Eurosystem moved to the next phase of the digital euro project in October 2025 and aims to be ready for potential first issuance during 2029, assuming EU legislation is adopted during 2026. The ECB frames the digital euro as a central-bank digital form of cash complementing banknotes and coins.
cards.evidenceClass: Official ECB CBDC project timeline / legislation and technical-readiness lane
cards.recordSupports: The money-rails clock is now tied to legislative timing, technical readiness, euro-area payment sovereignty, online/offline design, and the relationship between digital public money and existing private payment systems.
cards.notProven: This card does not prove criminal guilt, knowledge, intent, or participation unless the source itself is a court finding, plea, conviction, or other binding record.
cards.evidenceBoundary: A readiness target is not a final launch. Track legislation, pilots, wallet design, holding limits, privacy design, bank costs, merchant rules, and adoption requirements separately.

cards.claim: WHO Pandemic Agreement remains adopted but not fully open for ratification until PABS annex is negotiated
cards.sourceLabel: WHO Pandemic Agreement page and July 2026 IGWG listing
cards.summary: WHO states the Pandemic Agreement was adopted on 20 May 2025, but the next step is negotiation of the Pathogen Access and Benefit-Sharing system as an annex. WHO lists the seventh IGWG meeting on the Agreement for 6–17 July 2026.
cards.recordSupports: This is the current biosecurity governance lane: PABS, pathogen sharing, supply-chain/logistics network, finance mechanism, national ratification, and domestic implementation plans.
cards.notProven: This card does not prove criminal guilt, knowledge, intent, or participation unless the source itself is a court finding, plea, conviction, or other binding record.
cards.evidenceBoundary: Treaty adoption is not the same as force, ratification, domestic implementation, or WHO control over national measures. WHO states the agreement does not authorize it to impose lockdowns or vaccine mandates.
